title.narrative: Nepal National Stretegic Plan 2010-2015-Implementation of Stop TB Strategy - Nepal (16-Jul-2015-15-Mar-2018)

description.narrative: Nepal, Tuberculosis, Save the Children Federation, Inc. (STC HQ)This program has the following goals: Decrease the incidence of TB by 10 % by 2020 based on re-assessment of TB burden figures to be conducted in 2015. The objectives of this program are: Objective 1: Increase case detection by 15,000 cases from 37000 TB cases reported in 2013/14 (all forms of TB) by 2020. Objective 2: Maintain the treatment success rate at 90% patients (all forms of TB) by 2020. Objective 3: Provide MDR diagnostic services for 55% of persons with suspected MDR TB by 2017 and 100% by 2020; successfully treat at least 75 % of the diagnosed MDR patients. Objective 4: Engage 60% of all private health care providers (hospitals and practitioners) in TB control by 2017, and 80% by 2020. Objective 5: Strengthen community systems for management, advocacy, support and rights for TB patients in order to create an enabling environment to detect & manage TB cases in 60% of all districts by 2017 and 100% by 2020. Objective 6: Ensure availability of quality TB services, in line with current international standards and provided by qualified personnel, at 70% of all facilities by 2017 and 90% of the facilities by 2020

Percentage of TB patients who had an HIV test result recorded in the TB register
Number of notified cases of bacteriologically confirmed TB, new and relapses

Percentage of people living with HIV initiated on ART who are screened for TB in HIV treatment settings
Percentage of previously treated TB patients receiving DST (bacteriologically positive cases only)
